title: Prove the global two-chain invoice ceiling, including binary children (no new κ)
body:
The all-one (9,9) caller uniquely maximizes the raw crossing over every positive pair of chain lengths, every ordered child partition and every full binary child-tree invoice with #6833's accounting. Its crossing lies in (0.0033718004754, 0.0033718004755); no member becomes favorable later.

Strict concavity and a binary-node envelope cover all lengths and children; normalization by 9^(1-C) excludes later crossings. Concurrent #6836 independently checks the fixed 18-stage optimum and totals 10-40. This contribution proves the infinite-family ceiling and independently recounts the literal bill.

Base: 7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a.
Frozen #6833: ad24ad966b857dbfed50d9121624db84b2eccc92. Seven retained files have exact Git/SHA256 pins in ORIGINS.json.

Reproduce (Python 3.12, stdlib):
```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/chain-root-global-ceiling
```
Expected: PASS_CHAIN_ROOT_GLOBAL_CEILING twice and PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE.

Executed: separate proof/arithmetic review; normal/-O directed-integer certificate; whole-bracket adjacent signs and binary-envelope gap; source gate crossing; 961 length pairs and all 804 forest pairs with total leaves 2-7. Deterministic exhausted domains only corroborate the infinite proof. Twenty controls reject omitted costs, false optima, bad target axes and source mutations. Committed bytes/modes, export and Git-free replay pass. Complete remote tree equals tested contents.

No new κ. The native profile and node/idle accounting are fixed. All-parity and arbitrary-tree invoices form an upper-bound relaxation, not newly implemented suppliers. Changed root supports, native profiles or sharing rules remain open. Native replay, compiler admission and all five framework assumptions remain outside the theorem.

Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance and independent algebraic review. Credit DreamingOfClouds (#6833/#6824) and retained predecessors. Apache-2.0.
